title: Juicy Crisp Ethiopian Tomato Crumb
description: A savory and juicy post-workout dish featuring low-calorie-friendly tomato crumb over a bed of aromatic spices for an easy meal.

ingredients.name: clove of bread or whole wheat cracker crumbs

instructions: Blend tomatoes, onion, and garlic into a smooth paste.
Heat olive oil in a pan. Add cumin seeds, coriander seeds, turmeric powder, paprika, salt (to taste), and optionally baking soda until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add tomato paste to the pan and cook for an additional 5 minutes over medium heat.
Crush bread or whole wheat crumb in a blender or food processor until finely ground. Stir the crumbs into the tomato mixture.
Sprinkle breadcrumbs evenly on top of the tomato mixture, spreading it to cover the entire surface.
Bake at 350°F (175°C) for about 20 minutes or until golden brown and crispy.
